# `<net/socket.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Sockets: TCP and UDP through netd, over shared-memory rings.

Each app attaches to netd once, lazily on its first SockOpen(). Every socket is a memory object shared with netd that holds a [SockShm](#sockshm) header and one ring per direction; data never goes through IPC. The app rings netd's doorbell event after writing or reading, and netd signals the app's event when a socket changes. netd notices the app's death through a port the app owns.

Socket numbers are small integers local to the app, not handles.

```c
#include <net/socket.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="sock_ring_size"></a>`SOCK_RING_SIZE` | `8192u` | Bytes in each ring, per direction; a power of two. |
| <a id="sock_cmd_base"></a>`SOCK_CMD_BASE` | `0x100u` | First socket command number. netd's service port also speaks the one-byte [NetdOpcode](protocols/netd.md#netdopcode) protocol, so socket commands live above it. |
| <a id="sock_is_cmd"></a>`SOCK_IS_CMD(c)` |  | Tells whether a command number is a socket command. |
| <a id="sock_attach"></a>`SOCK_ATTACH` | `(SOCK_CMD_BASE + 1)` | Attach an app to netd. [SockAttachRequest](#sockattachrequest); grants the app's liveness port (PERM_WAIT \| PERM_TXFR). Replies [SockAttachReply](#sockattachreply) and grants netd's doorbell. |
| <a id="sock_notify"></a>`SOCK_NOTIFY` | `(SOCK_CMD_BASE + 2)` | Give netd the app's event. [SockNotifyRequest](#socknotifyrequest); grants the event. |
| <a id="sock_open"></a>`SOCK_OPEN` | `(SOCK_CMD_BASE + 3)` | Open a socket. [SockOpenRequest](#sockopenrequest); grants its memory object. Replies [SockOpenReply](#sockopenreply). |
| <a id="sock_bind"></a>`SOCK_BIND` | `(SOCK_CMD_BASE + 4)` | Bind a socket to a local port. [SockRequest](#sockrequest) {sock, port}; port 0 picks an ephemeral one. |
| <a id="sock_listen"></a>`SOCK_LISTEN` | `(SOCK_CMD_BASE + 5)` | Listen on a port. [SockRequest](#sockrequest) {sock, port, backlog}; TCP only. |
| <a id="sock_connect"></a>`SOCK_CONNECT` | `(SOCK_CMD_BASE + 6)` | Connect to a peer. [SockRequest](#sockrequest) {sock, ip, port}; completes asynchronously. |
| <a id="sock_accept"></a>`SOCK_ACCEPT` | `(SOCK_CMD_BASE + 7)` | Take a pending connection. [SockRequest](#sockrequest) {sock}; grants the new socket's memory object. Replies [SockOpenReply](#sockopenreply), or fails with ERR_BUFEMPTY if none is pending. |
| <a id="sock_close"></a>`SOCK_CLOSE` | `(SOCK_CMD_BASE + 9)` | Close a socket. [SockRequest](#sockrequest) {sock}. |
| <a id="sock_f_eof"></a>`SOCK_F_EOF` | `(1u << 0)` | SockShm::flags: the peer closed; the rx ring holds the last bytes. |
| <a id="sock_f_tx_kick"></a>`SOCK_F_TX_KICK` | `(1u << 1)` | SockShm::flags: netd drained tx and wants a doorbell on the next write. |
| <a id="sock_f_rx_kick"></a>`SOCK_F_RX_KICK` | `(1u << 2)` | SockShm::flags: rx was full; netd wants a doorbell after the app reads. |
| <a id="sock_hdr_bytes"></a>`SOCK_HDR_BYTES` | `256u` | Bytes reserved for [SockShm](#sockshm) before the rings. |
| <a id="sock_mem_bytes"></a>`SOCK_MEM_BYTES` | `(SOCK_HDR_BYTES + (2u * SOCK_RING_SIZE))` | Size of a socket's shared memory: header, tx ring, rx ring. |
| <a id="sock_mem_pages"></a>`SOCK_MEM_PAGES` | `((SOCK_MEM_BYTES + 4095u) / 4096u)` | Pages in a socket's memory object. |
| <a id="sock_dgram_max"></a>`SOCK_DGRAM_MAX` | `1472u` | Largest UDP payload: a 1500-byte MTU minus IP and UDP headers. |

## Enumerations

### `SockType` { #socktype }

Socket kind.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SOCK_KIND_TCP` | `1` | Stream socket. |
| `SOCK_KIND_UDP` | `2` | Datagram socket. |

### `SockState` { #sockstate }

Socket state, as netd publishes it in SockShm::state.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SOCK_STATE_OPEN` | `0` | Created, not bound or connected. |
| `SOCK_STATE_BOUND` | `1` | Bound to a local port. |
| `SOCK_STATE_LISTENING` | `2` | Accepting connections. |
| `SOCK_STATE_CONNECTING` | `3` | Connect in progress. |
| `SOCK_STATE_ESTABLISHED` | `4` | Connected. |
| `SOCK_STATE_CLOSED` | `5` | Finished; SockShm::error says why, ZUZU_OK for an orderly end. |

## Structures

### `SockShm` { #sockshm }

Header at the start of a socket's shared memory.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tx` | `ShmRingHdr` | App produces, netd consumes. |
| `rx` | `ShmRingHdr` | netd produces, app consumes. |
| `state` | `volatile uint32_t` | A [SockState](#sockstate). |
| `error` | `volatile int32_t` | Why the socket closed, once state is SOCK_STATE_CLOSED. |
| `flags` | `volatile uint32_t` | SOCK_F_* bits. |
| `rx_dropped` | `volatile uint32_t` | UDP datagrams dropped on a full rx ring. |
| `accept_pending` | `volatile uint32_t` | Connections waiting for SockAccept() on a listener. |
| `local_ip` | `uint32_t` | Local address. |
| `remote_ip` | `uint32_t` | Peer address, once connected. |
| `local_port` | `uint16_t` | Local port. |
| `remote_port` | `uint16_t` | Peer port, once connected. |

### `SockDgramHdr` { #sockdgramhdr }

Record header in a UDP ring; `len` payload bytes follow, padded to 4 bytes.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `peer_ip` | `uint32_t` | Sender (rx) or destination (tx) address. |
| `peer_port` | `uint16_t` | Sender or destination port. |
| `len` | `uint16_t` | Payload length. |

SOCK_ATTACH request.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cmd` | `uint32_t` | SOCK_ATTACH. |

| Field | Type | Description |

| `cmd` | `uint32_t` | SOCK_NOTIFY. |
| `session` | `uint32_t` | Session from [SockAttachReply](#sockattachreply). |
| `bit` | `uint32_t` | Bit netd rings on the app's event. |

### `SockOpenRequest` { #sockopenrequest }

SOCK_OPEN request.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cmd` | `uint32_t` | SOCK_OPEN. |
| `session` | `uint32_t` | Session from [SockAttachReply](#sockattachreply). |
| `kind` | `uint32_t` | A [SockType](#socktype). |

### `SockOpenReply` { #sockopenreply }

SOCK_OPEN and SOCK_ACCEPT reply.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [`Err`](../../errors.md#err) | ZUZU_OK, or why it failed. |
| `sock` | `uint32_t` | netd's id for the socket. |

### `SockRequest` { #sockrequest }

Request for the commands that act on an open socket.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cmd` | `uint32_t` | SOCK_BIND, SOCK_LISTEN, SOCK_CONNECT, SOCK_ACCEPT or SOCK_CLOSE. |
| `session` | `uint32_t` | Session from [SockAttachReply](#sockattachreply). |
| `sock` | `uint32_t` | netd's socket id. |
| `a` | `uint32_t` | First argument: port (bind, listen) or IP address (connect). |
| `b` | `uint32_t` | Second argument: backlog (listen) or port (connect). |

## Functions

### `SockOpen` { #sockopen }

```c
int SockOpen(SockType kind);
```

Opens a socket, attaching to netd first if this is the app's first one.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | in | SOCK_KIND_TCP or SOCK_KIND_UDP. |

**Returns:** The socket number, or a negative error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_SYSDOWN`](../../errors.md#err_sysdown) | /svc/netd is not registered. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../../errors.md#err_nomem) | Out of memory or handles. |

### `SockBind` { #sockbind }

```c
Err SockBind(int sock, uint16_t port);
```

Binds a socket to a local port.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sock` | in | Socket number. |
| `port` | in | Local port, or 0 for an ephemeral one. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `sock` is not an open socket. |

### `SockSendTo` { #socksendto }

```c
Err SockSendTo(int sock, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const void *buf, uint16_t len);
```

Queues one UDP datagram and rings netd.

Does not block.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sock` | in | Socket number. |
| `ip` | in | Destination address. |
| `port` | in | Destination port. |
| `buf` | in | Payload. |
| `len` | in | Payload length, at most SOCK_DGRAM_MAX. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `sock` is not an open socket. |
| [`ERR_OVERFLOW`](../../errors.md#err_overflow) | `len` is larger than SOCK_DGRAM_MAX. |
| [`ERR_NOTCONN`](../../errors.md#err_notconn) | The socket is closed. |
| [`ERR_BUFFULL`](../../errors.md#err_buffull) | The tx ring has no room; try again later. |

### `SockRecvFrom` { #sockrecvfrom }

```c
int SockRecvFrom(int sock, void *buf, uint16_t cap, uint32_t *ip, uint16_t *port, Duration timeout);
```

Receives one UDP datagram.

A datagram longer than `cap` is truncated and the rest discarded. While nothing has arrived it waits for socket activity; each wait may last up to `timeout`.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sock` | in | Socket number. |
| `buf` | out | Payload. |
| `cap` | in | Size of `buf`. |
| `ip` | out | Sender address; may be NULL. |
| `port` | out | Sender port; may be NULL. |
| `timeout` | in | Milliseconds, TIMEOUT_POLL or TIMEOUT_INFINITE. |

**Returns:** Bytes copied into `buf`, or a negative error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `sock` is not an open socket. |
| [`ERR_NOTCONN`](../../errors.md#err_notconn) | The socket is closed. |
| [`ERR_TIMEOUT`](../../errors.md#err_timeout) | Nothing arrived in time. |
| [`ERR_MALFORMED`](../../errors.md#err_malformed) | The rx ring was corrupt; it has been emptied. |

### `SockClose` { #sockclose }

```c
Err SockClose(int sock);
```

Closes a socket and releases its shared memory, even if netd reports an error.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sock` | in | Socket number. |

**Returns:** netd's answer to the close.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `sock` is not an open socket. |

### `SockConnect` { #sockconnect }

```c
Err SockConnect(int sock, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, Duration timeout);
```

Connects a TCP socket and waits until it is established or fails.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sock` | in | Socket number. |
| `ip` | in | Peer address. |
| `port` | in | Peer port. |
| `timeout` | in | Limit on each wait for progress: milliseconds, TIMEOUT_POLL or TIMEOUT_INFINITE. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK once established, or an error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `sock` is not an open socket. |
| [`ERR_TIMEOUT`](../../errors.md#err_timeout) | Still connecting. |
| [`ERR_NOTCONN`](../../errors.md#err_notconn) | The connection failed without a more specific error. |

### `SockListen` { #socklisten }

```c
Err SockListen(int sock, uint16_t port, int backlog);
```

Makes a TCP socket accept connections on a port.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sock` | in | Socket number. |
| `port` | in | Local port. |
| `backlog` | in | Connections netd queues before refusing more. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `sock` is not an open socket. |

### `SockAccept` { #sockaccept }

```c
int SockAccept(int sock, Duration timeout);
```

Takes the next connection from a listening socket.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sock` | in | Listening socket number. |
| `timeout` | in | Limit on each wait for a connection: milliseconds, TIMEOUT_POLL or TIMEOUT_INFINITE. |

**Returns:** The new connection's socket number, or a negative error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `sock` is not an open socket. |
| [`ERR_TIMEOUT`](../../errors.md#err_timeout) | No connection arrived in time. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../../errors.md#err_nomem) | Out of memory or handles. |

### `SockSend` { #socksend }

```c
int SockSend(int sock, const void *buf, uint32_t len);
```

Writes all of `buf` to a TCP socket, blocking while the tx ring is full.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sock` | in | Socket number. |
| `buf` | in | Data. |
| `len` | in | Bytes to send. |

**Returns:** `len`, or a negative error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `sock` is not an open socket. |
| [`ERR_NOTCONN`](../../errors.md#err_notconn) | The socket closed without a more specific error. |

### `SockRecv` { #sockrecv }

```c
int SockRecv(int sock, void *buf, uint32_t cap, Duration timeout);
```

Reads whatever a TCP socket has, up to `cap` bytes, waiting if it has nothing.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sock` | in | Socket number. |
| `buf` | out | Data. |
| `cap` | in | Size of `buf`. |
| `timeout` | in | Limit on each wait for data: milliseconds, TIMEOUT_POLL or TIMEOUT_INFINITE. |

**Returns:** Bytes read, 0 at end of stream, or a negative error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../../errors.md#err_badarg) | `sock` is not an open socket. |
| [`ERR_TIMEOUT`](../../errors.md#err_timeout) | No data arrived in time. |

### `SockWait` { #sockwait }

```c
Err SockWait(Duration timeout);
```

Waits until netd signals activity on any of the app's sockets.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `timeout` | in | Milliseconds, TIMEOUT_POLL or TIMEOUT_INFINITE. |

**Returns:** ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_NOTCONN`](../../errors.md#err_notconn) | No socket has been opened yet. |
| [`ERR_TIMEOUT`](../../errors.md#err_timeout) | Nothing happened in time. |
